subject: Re: FOI — Mary Williams probate records — death certificate enclosed
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Disclosure Team,

Further to your email of 28 July 2026 requesting a copy of the death
certificate for Mary Williams before you can process my FOI request
concerning her probate records, please find the death certificate attached.

Mary Williams (also known as Mary Buckler following her marriage to
Frederick Buckler — see attached extracts from her statement) died in March
1983. She was the occupier and asserted owner of Great House Farm (Ty Mawr
alias Cedfin aka Cedwyn), Llandough-juxta-Penarth, Cardiff.

My request, submitted 7 June 2026, seeks access to any probate records,
wills, affidavits, or ownership claim documents referenced in court
proceedings relating to Mary Williams and Great House Farm, Llandough,
particularly in connection with the proceedings recorded in BP Properties
Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2.

Please can you confirm receipt and advise the expected response date.

With talk of civil war on the horizon and already a lot of government
fiduciaries in less possession of records than I am in possession of, due
to so much destruction of property and records and gaps in records by the
government in this case, I am keen to salvage what remains of my family's
history and heritage so that the historians and I at the Welsh settlement
in Argentina can celebrate my family's homes and strongholds, Welsh history
and heritage, rather than waiting more than the almost years we have
already waited for the British State to stop its endless war it has waged
on us to ethnically cleanse us indigenous Britons from our ancestral
birthland in Wales. We'll just return if/when someone overthrows this
terrorist organisation, the British State we now seem to be harbouring on
the British Isles. All fear and respect for the United Kingdom government
has gone for our family. Few care if you now bring guns and finish the job
of erasing us, as they have lived four decades in what is effectively the
concentration work-camp conditions our towns and cities have been turned
into.

But before our county treasure, the former courthouse manorial 10-bedroom
courthouse, was demolished, or looted of all our furniture from Cardiff by
what appears to be SAS under cover as BP bailiffs, I do remember a
different realm from the one now blocking out the sun on the British Isles.
A realm less demonic, on our sacred Welsh Christian stronghold, upon which
the suppressed history and heritage once stood: the Roman villa and
medieval burial site and Celtic 2,200-year-old roundhouse and monastery.
And Marconi staying with us while inventing radio, or world champion boxer
Peerless Jim Driscoll fighting his first fight in our barns. Today there is
no history tourist-board plaque, no park-bench plaque. Just 20
characterless houses, 13 of which are on our stolen occupied land.

As a bona fide, certified and experienced military commander and leader and
warfare professional and war veteran, who was subject of this siege on our
land and home in 1988, I have to say it is important to call a kettle black
and call this what it was and is. This is all synonymous with a terrorist
organisation, network or cell, committing an act of terrorism. Establishing
a terrorist camp for its officers or PoW/hostages. Following an act of
terrorism (my pregnant mum also thrown over our gate, into a puddle,
collarbone dislocated, just for seeking medicine for my father who lay in
the hospital bed after police left him in a cell and ignored him,
complaining of a heart attack for six hours).

My family have lived as terrified hostage-like prisoners of war under the
British State in Wales. Too frightened to speak up or out about any of
this. Since everyone who has challenged acquiescing in our own replacement
in my family, on our land since 1667, seems to have died at very convenient
timings.

I don't fully understand how deep this all goes. I suspect it was a
military operation disguised as a civilian action. Perhaps hybrid warfare
annexure of our land as some of the last in Wales to fall victim to British
State imperialsim. Our home was literally looted of our furniture from
Cardiff castle. Our lands were literally looted of medieval burials.
Including roman coins and so forth. Much of which ended up in a suspicious
fire in Neath.

I have called for a public enquiry from the Senedd. But it seems the fight
to keep burying us alive is a never ending one.

I wish you all the best with the civil war you've waged on us indigenous
Britons on our ancestral birthland. I see the British State for what it is
now. A terrorist organisation my countrymen will surely soon stop
harbouring on our island.

I think there's a small window of opportunity in our families case for your
regime to even just take a break from trying to make us into striped pjamad
hostages. And allow us to restore even parts of our dignity and minor
gentry manorial 800 year old home and 4 century of occupancy before you
stole and destroyed it by force.

We don't even seek to try to enjoy our language, history and herritage
under this terrorist anarcho tyrant ethnic cleansing demonic realm regime
in Wales anymore. We're committed to rebuilding the replica of our former
home in Patagonia where our existence and culture and language and
herritage as a race and ethnicity, isn't being actively exterminated and
concealed and supressed.

I did my 22 years in Oath. Served in war. I'm bona fide, left my military
career with full honours. I'm a warfare professional and certified and
experienced military commander and leader. And I can't even get back basic
FOI's, after almost a year from many branches of your government. And I
don't think its all negigence or incompetence.

I think there's concealment and fraud and government involvement and your
government are in dishonour and are a disgrace in this whole case and
treatment of my family and our home and history and herritage.

I feel having brought all this to everyone's attention. Which was also very
difficult and sensitive to do considering nobody in my family will even
speak up or out about it. To be met with such negligence and incompetence
and obtuse, hostile, unco-operative, railroading and gatekeeping and delay
is a disgrace.

This is nothing short of a nightmare under a demonic realm in a
concentration work camp where we're being ethnically cleansed and ignored.
There is no democracy here. There is no peace here.

Church View Close Llandough was once our lands of centuries. Its been
nothing short of a crime scene since BP arrived onto the scene in 1969.
It's only in these last few decades of the beautiful undisturbed centuries
of life on our land overlooking Cardiff, WHICH WE STILL OWN, despite you
lot illegally occupying it - its only in the last few decades we've seen
all this ethnic cleansing British imperialism turned inwards on us.

The evidence is all in this case. The words I use to describe this are
strong, but are actually proportionate to what has happened in this case.
And is ongoing because nothing and nobody is doing a thing to undo this
dogs dinner of a society.

Yours sincerely,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)
Royal Signals Cyber/Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member
Williams/Buckler Family — Great House Farm, Llandough
